learnings.claim: The official YouTube Data API quota calculator (fetched 2026-10-09) states that search.list and videos.insert have their own quota buckets with a default of 100 calls per day at cost 1 per call, other endpoints share 10,000 units per day, invalid requests still cost at least one point, and daily quotas reset at midnight Pacific Time.
learnings.decision: SHORTS_UPLOAD_QUOTA_GATE: budget uploads against the separate 100/day videos.insert bucket, not the 10,000-unit pool; count failed/invalid calls too; schedule the quota-day boundary at 00:00 PT (10:00 TRT during PDT). Thumbnails.set (50) and videos.update (50) still draw from the shared pool.
fallback_history: If the upload bucket is exhausted, keep the rendered MP4 artifact and retry after the PT reset; never fall back to a paid tool.
learnings.next_measurement: On the first real upload run record quotaExceeded/uploadLimitExceeded errors and the Cloud console quota page value; until then upload quota is unverified for this project.
learnings.title: YouTube videos.insert own quota bucket

learnings.claim: The official videos.insert reference (fetched 2026-10-09) states that if status.privacyStatus is not specified the uploaded video defaults to public (some accounts default to private), and that status.containsSyntheticMedia and status.selfDeclaredMadeForKids are settable on insert.
learnings.decision: SHORTS_EXPLICIT_PRIVACY_GATE: youtube-upload must always send an explicit status.privacyStatus (private until Furkan approves publish) plus explicit selfDeclaredMadeForKids and containsSyntheticMedia for AI-voiced/synthetic Shorts; a request missing these fields is blocked before calling the API.
fallback_history: Without OAuth secrets keep uploads in dry-run and store the request body as an artifact for review.
learnings.next_measurement: After the first authorised upload, read back the video resource and confirm privacyStatus and containsSyntheticMedia match the request.
learnings.title: YouTube upload privacyStatus default is public
